note: Discrete quarterly periods (3-month, not year-to-date). Values in USD as reported.
source: SEC XBRL inline instance documents for the ten 10-Q/10-K filings covering 2024 Q1 through 2026 Q2, cross-checked against the rendered financial statements (FilingSummary R-files) and the Q2 2026 earnings release (Ex-99.1).
conventions_and_quirks: Sign convention: values are as tagged in the XBRL instance documents, i.e. the raw signed value, not the presentation sign. Expenses and cash outflows are therefore POSITIVE (e.g. cost_of_revenue, opex_*, interest_expense, cf_capex_*, cf_common_stock_issuance_costs), while losses and net cash used are NEGATIVE (operating_income_loss, net_loss_*, cf_net_cash_used_in_operating).

opex_gain_on_asset_disposals_contra is presented by LODE as a negative (contra) line inside total operating expenses. It is stored here as a POSITIVE number, so total operating expenses = SG&A + R&D + D&A + goodwill/intangible impairment + PP&E impairment - opex_gain_on_asset_disposals_contra.

Discrete 3-month contexts are tagged by LODE for Q1, Q2 and Q3 of every year, so those quarters are read directly rather than derived. Only Q4 (and a handful of individual line items) required subtraction; every such value has an entry in derivation_notes.

1-for-10 REVERSE STOCK SPLIT effective 2025-02-24. EPS and weighted-average share counts for 2024 quarters are the RESTATED (post-split) figures taken from the 2025 comparative columns. Period-end shares issued/outstanding for 2024 Q1-Q3 are as-originally-reported and are therefore PRE-split, because no later filing restates those balance-sheet dates; use the *_split_adjusted fields for a continuous post-split series.

LODE mis-assigns the XBRL context date of the prior-year-end comparative balance-sheet column in several 10-Qs (for example the Q1-2025 10-Q tags 2024-12-31 total assets of $91,309,881 against a 2024-03-31 instant, and the Q1-2026 10-Q tags the 2025-12-31 balance sheet against a 2025-03-31 instant). Every balance-sheet value here is therefore taken only from the filing whose own report date equals the balance-sheet date.
Quarterly cash flow statements are published YTD only. Discrete-quarter cash flow values are derived by subtracting the prior YTD; the *_ytd fields carry the as-reported YTD figure.

LODE presents no gross profit line; gross_profit here is revenue_total - cost_of_revenue. Cost of revenue is reported as $0 for all three reported quarters of 2024 and first appears as a non-zero figure in the FY2024 10-K ($451,938, all of it therefore falling in Q4 2024).

No exploration or pre-development expense line exists in the 2024-2026 income statements; those costs sit inside SG&A and R&D. Selling and marketing vs general and administrative are not split on the face of the statements (a single SG&A line is presented) but ARE split in the segment note, which is where opex_selling_and_marketing and opex_general_and_administrative come from.

Equity-method affiliates as of 2026-06-30 are Sierra Springs Opportunity Fund, Inc. (SSOF, 47.63%, $49,011,855) and, until it was written to zero in Q2 2026, a 40%-held research and development company ($1,079,371 at 2025-12-31). Green Li-ion Pte Ltd (11.98%) is carried at $18,201,065 under the alternative measurement method, not equity method. LINICO is consolidated, not equity method. GenMat / Quantum Generative Materials is no longer carried as an equity-method investment in these periods.
No income tax expense or benefit is recognised in any quarter (full valuation allowance); there is no pre-tax vs after-tax distinction to model.

2024 Q4 is distorted by two large non-cash items that must not be extrapolated. Revenue of $1,599,005 (versus roughly $425k-$556k in 2024 Q1-Q3) includes $1,562,499 of deferred revenue from the 2023 Mackay Mining Lease recognised on the December 2024 sale of the related mineral interest (Comstock Northern Exploration LLC) to Mackay; that is why current deferred revenue falls from $1,236,645 at 2024-09-30 to $151,939 at 2024-12-31. R&D of $14,217,336 in the same quarter is almost entirely the $12,244,538 of non-cash research and development cost recognised on the GenMat transaction.

Mackay is a recurring counterparty, not a new one: it took the 2023 mining lease, bought Comstock Northern Exploration LLC in December 2024, and is the buyer of the whole legacy mining business under the June 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement.

cf_stock_based_compensation is unreliable and materially understates equity-settled compensation. FY2024 as tagged is $41,799 even though 9M-2024 was $142,482, so the derived 2024 Q4 figure is negative (-$100,683); that is what the filings say, not an extraction error. Separately, LODE settles large amounts of compensation and expense in stock through other lines: research and development expense paid with common stock ($1,208,180 in FY2024, $1,487,476 in FY2025), interest expense paid with common stock ($527,541 in FY2024, $401,523 in FY2025), and $1,864,159 of director share-based compensation in 2026 Q1 alone.

LODE re-tags individual line items between filings, so where a Q1 value as originally tagged disagreed materially with (1H YTD minus discrete Q2) from a later filing, the later filing's tagging was used. One case mattered: the Q1-2025 10-Q put the $845,000 gain on extinguishment of a LIABILITY into us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt, which would double count it against lode:GainLossOnExtinguishmentOfLiability. gain_loss_on_extinguishment_of_debt for 2025 Q1 is therefore 0, and the $845,000 sits only in gain_loss_on_extinguishment_of_liability. Similarly the 2025 Q3 SAFE-note remeasurement of $900,000 is tagged lode:ChangeInFairValueOfCommitments rather than lode:ChangeInFairValueOfDebt; both tags feed change_in_fv_of_safe_note here.

Quarterly figures sum to the audited full year exactly for 2024 and 2025 on revenue, cost of revenue and net loss. Total operating expenses and operating loss for 2024 differ from the full year by $1, which is LODE's own rounding between its quarterly and annual columns, not an extraction error.

From 2025 Q4 onward LODE reuses the us-gaap:DerivativeLiabilitiesCurrent tag for a balance sheet caption called 'Deferred liabilities' ($199,695 at 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31, $432,065 at 2026-06-30), which is not a derivative. Over 2026 the derivative position is an ASSET (derivative_assets_current, $2,006,187 at 2026-06-30). Treat derivative_liabilities_current as a genuine derivative liability only through 2025 Q3.

Revenue facts carrying the EquityMethodInvestmentNonconsolidatedInvesteeAxis dimension are the revenue of the equity-method INVESTEES (summarised investee financial information), not LODE revenue or related-party revenue. They are excluded here; including them would double count.

No discontinued operations in any period. The legacy mining asset sale is classified as HELD FOR SALE, NOT part of a disposal group treated as discontinued operations (us-gaap:AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupCurrent, and the XBRL member used is 'Disposal Group, Held-for-Sale, Not Discontinued Operations'). Mining segment revenue and expenses remain in continuing operations for every period shown.

segment_structure.presentation: The segment note first totals Metals + Mining + Strategic Investments + Corporate/Other into a "Total of Segments before Bioleum Corp." column, then adds Bioleum to reach consolidated.

descriptions.Bioleum (Fuels): Lignocellulosic biomass converted into biointermediates for refining into renewable fuels. CODM is the President of Bioleum. No revenue in any period shown.
descriptions.Metals: Recycling of electrification products (end-of-life solar panels). CODM is the President of the Metals segment.
descriptions.Mining: Gold and silver mining assets and related real estate; revenue is from leasing mineral claims and other real estate. CODM is its President and the CFO. Classified as held for sale from 2026 Q1.
descriptions.Strategic Investments: Investments in Green Li-ion and SSOF. CODM is the CEO.
descriptions.Corporate / Other: All other assets and general corporate costs. CODM is the CEO.

legacy_mining_asset_sale.classification: held for sale, NOT discontinued operations
legacy_mining_asset_sale.counterparty: Mackay Precious Metals Inc. / Mackay Gold & Silver Corp.
entities_sold: Comstock Real Estate Inc. (Gold Hill Hotel)
legacy_mining_asset_sale.consideration_detail: Per the 10-Q: $20,000,000 stated consideration comprising 2,000,000 Mackay Parent shares, a $7,000,000 receivable over 18 months secured at 12%, up to $2,000,000 additional value of shares receivable, plus $10,000,000 of contingent consideration over 7 years and a 1.5% NSR royalty with a Mackay repurchase right ($3,500,000, or $7,000,000 once the contingent payment lapses). The earnings release describes total consideration of over $45.0 million including $20.0 million of cash at closing.
legacy_mining_asset_sale.expected_close: August 2026, subject only to TSX-V clearance
legacy_mining_asset_sale.modeling_implication: Because the disposal is held for sale rather than discontinued operations, NO prior period is restated and Mining segment revenue stays inside continuing-operations revenue in every quarter of this file. Mining revenue is only about $33k per quarter (real-estate and mineral-claim leases) so the revenue that disappears on closing is immaterial; what changes materially is the balance sheet (roughly $23.0m of assets and $6.8m of liabilities, including the reclamation liability, leave the balance sheet) plus about $0.6m per quarter of Mining segment G&A, and a gain or loss on sale lands in the quarter of closing (expected 2026 Q3).

impairments.2024 Q3: Goodwill and intangible asset impairment $8,667,869 (LINICO / Comstock Metals related) plus $324,047 of PP&E impairment.
impairments.2025 Q3: Goodwill and intangible asset impairment $9,333 plus $433,411 of PP&E impairment.
impairments.2026 Q2: Flux Photon and related technologies written off in Bioleum: $13,648,042 of developed-technology intangibles, $1,736,481 of capitalized engineering costs for plant designs (in PP&E not yet placed in service), and $1,031,371 of associated investments (below the operating line, in gain_loss_on_investments). Total approximately $16.4 million ($16,415,894), described by the company as substantially all non-cash acquisition costs.

data_not_found: eps_basic, eps_diluted, wavg_shares_basic and wavg_shares_diluted for 2024 Q4 and 2025 Q4: weighted-average share counts are not additive across periods, so Q4 cannot be derived by subtraction and LODE does not disclose a Q4-only figure. Left null rather than approximated.

restricted cash: LODE presents no restricted cash line on the balance sheet for any period. The reclamation bond deposit (reclamation_bond_deposit) is the closest analogue and is classified as a non-current deposit, not restricted cash.

accounts_receivable_current for 2024 Q2 and 2024 Q3: the 2024 balance sheets carried no separate accounts receivable line (receivables sat inside prepaid expenses and other current assets); it first appears as its own caption later.

goodwill for 2024 Q1-Q3 and 2025 Q2-Q3: not tagged separately in those filings. Goodwill was $0 at 2024-12-31 (the LINICO goodwill was written off in the Q3 2024 $8,667,869 impairment) and $1,507,154 from 2025 Q1 onward (Hexas Biomass). Use goodwill_and_intangibles_total for a continuous series.
wavg_shares_diluted is separately tagged only in 2024 Q1 and 2024 Q3; in every loss-making period LODE states that basic and diluted are identical and tags a single combined line.
derivative_assets_current at 2024-06-30: not tagged (the position was a net derivative LIABILITY of $4,400,579 at that date).
cf_proceeds_from_issuance_of_equity_in_subsidiary is only present in the periods where it occurred (Bioleum Corporation, 2024 Q3/Q4 and 2025 Q3/Q4); absent elsewhere.

current vs long-term debt for 2026 Q1 and 2026 Q2: LODE had no conventional debt outstanding at those dates. The only debt-like instrument is the Marathon SAFE note, carried at fair value in long-term liabilities and reported here as safe_note_convertible_noncurrent ($12,000,000 at 2026-03-31 and $10,900,000 at 2026-06-30).

Technology / licensing / service revenue: LODE does not disclose such a revenue category in any period. Its only revenue types are Mining and Real Estate, Recycling, Decommissioning Services and Off-take.
Segment-level cost of revenue, opex and assets exist in the segment note but are not captured in this file beyond revenue; only revenue is disaggregated by segment here.
